content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (LD), high severity.**

- **Responsive clause:** § 7.7 (p0032) — the only Customer-payable liquidated amount in the agreement. Sweeps of §§ 2, 3, 10, 22, 27 confirm no early-termination fee, minimum-use charge, or other Customer LD (§ 27 expressly allows termination "without penalty"; § 22 shortfall payments are audited quantity true-ups, not liquidated damages).
- **Why it fails:** 15% of annual Fees per week of late payment, triggered by a ten-day payment delay, compounds past the remaining contract value — walk-away territory, and there is no fallback early-termination-fee bargain to preserve.
- **Cure:** one surgical replace of 7.7 with an unconditional statement that Customer bears no liquidated damages or penalties; Vendor's ordinary non-payment remedies and the § 7.3 dispute mechanic are untouched.
